title: salix lapponum var. jacquinii
intro: Salix lapponum var. jacquinii, commonly known as Lapp's willow, is a plant species belonging to the willow family (Salicaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Lapp's willow include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antioxidant effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as salicin and flavonoids. The bioactive compounds in Lapp's willow have been shown to have a synergistic effect, contributing to its therapeutic properties.
